title: Powerful! AI Cockpit Gains a New Strong Force, FAW-Volkswagen's New Electric Star Officially Joins Doubao Large Model

content_html:
On August 14, Yuchuan Engine released the latest news that the new all-electric model of FAW-Volkswagen, the ID. AURA T6, has officially started blind reservations and has confirmed access to the Doubao large model.

As an important upgrade of their cooperation, FAW-Volkswagen and Yuchuan Engine have already begun in-depth cooperation in the field of intelligent cockpit. Previously, they have successfully covered all the fuel-powered models of the brand. The addition of the ID. AURA T6 marks the official expansion of their intelligent cooperation into the field of pure electric new energy vehicles.
